# MemOS

> MemOS is a universal, local-first, persistent memory layer for AI agents and LLMs. It gives any LLM a memory that survives restarts — graph-native SQLite storage, temporal validity, trust scoring, and a compact format that cuts context tokens by ~77%. 100% local, no cloud, no API keys, MIT licensed, free forever.

MemOS is part of the AI Trio: [Universal MCP Toolkit](https://github.com/Markgatcha/universal-mcp-toolkit) (MCP transport + tools), MemOS (memory + persistence), and [LLM Guardian](https://github.com/Markgatcha/llm-guardian) (token-cost optimization).

## Install

- TypeScript/Node.js: `npm install @mem-os/sdk`
- Python (PyPI): `pip install mem-os-sdk` (requires Node.js 18+ at runtime)
- Docker: `git clone https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos.git && cd memos && docker compose up -d`
- Start the HTTP server: `memos-server` → http://localhost:7400

## Docs

- [Home / Overview](https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos/blob/main/docs/index.md): core concepts — memory nodes, typed edges, the graph, SQLite storage
- [Installation](https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos/blob/main/docs/installation.md): step-by-step setup for npm, Python, and Docker, with troubleshooting
- [API Reference](https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos/blob/main/docs/api-reference.md): every SDK method — store, search, summarize, link, getGraph, getNeighbours
- [Adapters](https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos/blob/main/docs/adapters.md): Ollama, LangChain, and custom adapter integrations
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos/blob/main/docs/benchmark-comparison.md): BEAM-1M recall 95.9% vs Mem0 64.1%; LoCoMo and LongMemEval parity
- [Benchmark Quality](https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos/blob/main/docs/benchmark-quality.md): methodology and context-pack format spec
- [AI Trio Contracts](https://github.com/Markgatcha/memos/blob/main/docs/ai-trio-contracts.md): how MemOS, UMT, and LLM Guardian compose

## Key facts

- Storage: SQLite (WAL mode, FTS5) at `~/.memos/memos.db` — configurable via `MEMOS_DB_PATH`
- Server: HTTP API on port 7400 (`MEMOS_PORT` to change), health at `/health`, docs at `/docs`
- Embeddings: local (Gemma-300M) by default — no API key required
- MCP: built-in adapter, stdio + HTTP/SSE (`npx -y @mem-os/sdk mcp`)
- Memory features: temporal validity (validFrom/validTo), trust scoring, provenance, confidence state machine, compact TOON format (77.6% token savings vs JSON)
- License: MIT — free to use, modify, and ship; no paid tier
